notes:
What's new in 2.2.0:
• Saturday and makeup-day classes now correctly appear in the Home card and all widgets (dated-sheet engine fix)
• Server-side push notifications: timetable/exam/event changes land in minutes, even with the app fully closed
• Manual widget refresh is now instant even on battery-restricted phones
• New Send Feedback screen (More tab → Send Feedback, and About)
• Custom timetable course picker: smooth full-panel scrolling plus an always-visible draggable scroll wheel
